title: Uruguayan Sushi Bowl
description: A fusion of Uruguayan flavors in a sushi-inspired bowl, featuring unique ingredients.

ingredients.name: Unique Chopped Onions
ingredients.notes: pickled onions add a tangy crunch

ingredients.name: Sushi Nori
ingredients.notes: dried seaweed sheets for sushi rolls

instructions: Cook Japanese Rice according to package instructions.
Prepare Unique Chopped Onions by pickling them in a mixture of lime juice and water for at least 30 minutes.
Grill Cevapi Meat to an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
Cut the cooked cevapi into bite-sized pieces.
Assemble the sushi bowl by placing a scoop of sushi rice at the bottom, followed by sliced cevapi, Unique Chopped Onions, and sliced avocado.
Garnish with Fresh Cilantro, Sesame Seeds, and a drizzle of Lime Juice.
